topic: FL 21.2.2 enabled MIDI inputs re-broadcast to all numbered outputs; relay/loopMIDI storm laws

evidence.storm: 85553 relay note events in ~51s (~1670 ev/s) on shared base loopMIDI Port with FL input enabled; no transport running
evidence.matrix: post-reboot write-one-note-per-output map: multi-input bleed while 4 FL inputs enabled; strict 1:1 same-port loops after RX-only enable + blanked untended output numbers
evidence.clean: single channels.preview_note(ch=1) -> sendlog exactly 2 entries (on vel90 / off vel0 at +215..227ms), audible MicroFreak one-shot, zero residual growth

laws: enable only controller/automation FL input rows
blank output port numbers nobody explicitly targets
hardware/relay lanes need a dedicated tenant-free loopMIDI port
relaunch relays DRY first and verify single-shot sendlog balance
use --max-seconds bounded runs until topology proven

secondary_pitfalls.winmm_suffix_drift: mido names gain/lose enumeration suffix across reboots (loopMIDI Port 2 4 -> 2 3); resolve by base-name substring
secondary_pitfalls.driver_graph_corruption: ports can stop looping after churn while FL holds endpoints; cure is reboot
secondary_pitfalls.daemon_reader_stall: daemon TCP alive, heartbeat_age grows, FL actually sends (queued SysEx on cable); cure is daemon restart
